* **You have applied AI, not only chatted with it**. What have you built? Tell us about an app on an LLM API, a custom agent or MCP server, a boring task you automated end to end, or a simple eval you used to compare prompts or models.
* **You stay curious and sceptical**. You ask why the AI gave an answer, and you check it before you trust it.
* **You learn fast**. You are excited to learn new things. You are comfortable when you do not know something yet, and you ask good questions.

Tell us about:

* **The coolest one**: the thing you are most proud of, or the thing that made people say "wait, how?"
* Or **the hardest one**: the thing that broke many times before it worked.

For each one, tell us:

* **The problem**: what you wanted to solve, and why it mattered to you.
* **What you built**: what you built, compared to what the AI did.
* **What broke**: where the AI failed, and how you found and fixed the problem.
* **The result**: a link to a repo, a demo, a video, or a write-up. A result that works with rough edges is better than slides that look polished.

**BUILD WHAT MATTERS. GROW WITH CENTINUS.**

At Centinus, infrastructure, reliability, and quality are essential parts of the product. You will help establish the foundation, make decisions with lasting impact, and expand your scope as the company grows.

* Build and own foundational systems that operate beyond the lab in demanding real-world environments.

**Imagine: A Career with Purpose and Possibility**

Picture this: You are part of a global team of problem-solvers whose innovations in materials science can make life better. Every day, you help turn ideas into impact using science, technology, and creativity to tackle real-world challenges. You’re part of a company whose work helps improve patient outcomes in healthcare and protects essential consumer goods that people around the world rely on every day.

You will help protect the integrity of essential products, support patient safety and comfort, and contribute to innovations that make everyday life better, all while building a career that makes an impact.

Because at TekniPlex, you don’t just deliver products – you help shape what’s next.

**What is the role where you will make an impact?**

**Process Automation Controls Engineer III:**

As the Process Automation Controls Engineer owns the automation, controls, and plant-floor data systems that keep a multi-building manufacturing facility running.

This role spans PLC and HMI programming, SCADA and data historian systems, the industrial network, and the servers that support them. The engineer supports daily production, drives reliability and OEE improvements, and leads controls upgrades from design through commissioning. It is a hands-on role for someone who is as comfortable with a laptop plugged into a PLC on the floor as with SQL queries and network switches.

**What will you do in this technical role?**

  

**Controls & Equipment**

* Program, troubleshoot, and modify PLCs and HMIs across a mixed-vendor plant, primarily Rockwell/Allen-Bradley, with Siemens, Schneider/Modicon, Omron, AutomationDirect, and Unitronics equipment.
* Support production equipment including extruders, laminators, presses, winders, and utility systems (HVAC, cooling tower, tank farm); respond to controls-related downtime.
* Lead drive upgrades, retrofits, and machine revamps: scope, design, electrical schematics, panel changes, programming, and startup.
* Read, create, and maintain electrical drawings, size power supplies, protection, and components.

**SCADA, Data & Software**

* Develop and maintain Ignition SCADA (Perspective and Vision) for HMI, OEE tracking, recipe management, and machine and utility monitoring.
* Maintain data historian and database systems (PostgreSQL, Microsoft SQL Server), including tag historization, named queries, and audit logging.
* Manage OPC and connectivity layers such as Kepware / TOP Server; support legacy FactoryTalk and Wonderware systems during migration.
* Support production-monitoring platforms (e.g., Shoplogix) and plant display boards; build dashboards and reports for operations and process engineering.
* Write and maintain scripts (Python/Jython, SQL) for automation, data handling, and reporting.

**Infrastructure & Network**

* Administer the industrial/OT network: managed switches, VLANs, and device IP management, in coordination with corporate IT.
* Maintain control-system servers and virtual machines, backups, software licensing, and Windows / Active Directory accounts for OT systems.
* Support plant security systems such as badge access and camera systems (UniFi).

**Continuous Improvement & Documentation**

* Identify and implement automation projects that improve uptime, quality, safety, and OEE.
* Keep programs, network drawings, IP lists, credentials, and system documentation current and backed up.
* Work closely with maintenance, process engineering, production, and IT; train technicians and operators on new systems.
* Follow and promote plant safety practices, including LOTO, arc-flash, and machine guarding requirements.

**What skills do you bring to the role?**

* Five or more years of controls related experience
* Strong PLC programming and troubleshooting skills in Rockwell Studio 5000 / RSLogix (ladder logic required; structured text a plus).
* Experience developing HMI/SCADA applications (Ignition preferred; FactoryTalk View or similar acceptable).
* Working knowledge of SQL databases and industrial communication protocols (EtherNet/IP, Modbus, OPC UA).
* Ability to read and create electrical schematics and troubleshoot control panels, VFDs, and field I/O.
* Solid networking fundamentals: IP addressing, subnets, VLANs, managed switches.
* Willingness to support production outside normal hours when needed.

**Preferred**

* Ignition Core or Gold certification.
* Experience with Kepware, FactoryTalk Transaction Manager, Wonderware, or Grafana.
* Python or Jython scripting experience.
* Experience with OEE systems, recipe management, or historian migrations.
* Background in plastics, extrusion, or converting processes.
* Exposure to Siemens TIA Portal, Omron, or other non-Rockwell platforms.
* Familiarity with UniFi / Ubiquiti network and security products, VMware or Hyper-V, and Active Directory.
